New formula and epithet renderings for iliad-044 (7.283–378), in the table format of conventions.md. Reused wherever the table or a published part already had the line (7.287, 7.293a, 7.319–320, 7.326/367, 7.348–349/368–369 take the published English; 7.316–318 take the Odyssey’s and iliad-005’s; 7.321 νώτοισιν … διηνεκέεσσι γέραιρεν takes the Odyssey’s "chines" of odyssey-070; 7.347 takes the existing formula for ἦρχ’ ἀγορεύειν, "was the first to speak among them"; neither is a new row). No row below departs from an Odyssey rendering of the same word in the same use.

| Greek | `l` | `i` | avoided on purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| τὸν δ’ ἀπαμειβόμενος προσέφη Τελαμώνιος Αἴας (7.283, whole-line reply-formula) | "Him answering addressed Telamonian Ajax:" | "In answer Telamonian Ajax said to him:" | "answered" (reserved for ἠμείβετο); follows the table's ἀπαμειβόμενος προσέφη rows and Τελαμώνιος Αἴας "Telamonian Ajax" |
| ἀρχέτω (7.286, "let him begin") | "let him begin;" | "let him begin;" | "let him lead" (ἄρχω "lead" is kept for ἀρχεύειν, 5.200); ἄρχω "begin" with an infinitive is the table's ἤρχετο ὑφαίνειν |
| θεῖον ἀγῶνα (7.298; sense uncertain) | "the divine gathering" | "the divine gathering" (+ note: place not stated) | "the temples", "the sacred contest", "the gods' assembly" (each decides what is meant); ἀγών "gathering" as in the table (8.200), θεῖος "divine" |
| ἑλκεσιπέπλους (Τρῳάδας, 7.297) | "trailing-robed" | "with their trailing robes" | the shipped iliad-040 rendering (6.442), unchanged |
| τελαμών (of a sword, ἐϋτμήτῳ τελαμῶνι, 7.304) | "well-cut strap" | "well-cut strap" | "baldric", "belt" (ζωστήρ is "belt"); the table's τελαμών is "strap" / "shield-strap" (2.388), and the note says this one carries the sword |
| ὅμαδος (ἐς Τρώων ὅμαδον, 7.307) | "uproar" | "noisy crowd" | "throng" (reserved for ὅμιλος), "din", "host"; ὅμαδος is the noise a crowd makes, and so the crowd; the shipped "uproar" for ὅμαδος δ’ ἦν (2.96) kept in `l` |
| ὀξὺς Ἄρης (7.330) | "sharp Ares" | "sharp Ares" | "keen", "swift", "bitter", "fierce" (each picks a sense); ὀξύς is "sharp" of spears and bronze in the published parts |
| τετρηχυῖα (of an assembly, ἀγορὴ δεινὴ τετρηχυῖα, 7.346) | "dreadful, in turmoil" | "a dreadful one, in turmoil" | "rough" (kept for τρηχύς), "tumultuous", "stormy"; the shipped "in turmoil" for τετρήχει ἀγορή (2.95) |
| ἵνα μὴ ῥέξομεν ὧδε (7.353) | "unless we do thus" | "unless we do this" | "so that we may not do thus" (the purpose sense gives nonsense here); the note says ἵνα μή is awkward and that "unless" is the sense needed |
| ὅς μιν ἀμειβόμενος ἔπεα πτερόεντα προσηύδα (7.356, relative-clause speech introduction) | "who, answering him, winged words spoke:" | "who in answer to him spoke winged words:" | "addressed" (reserved for προσέφη); the table's ἔπεα πτερόεντα προσηύδα "spoke winged words", with ἀμειβόμενος "answering" |
| ἀντικρὺ … ἀπόφημι (7.362) | "straight out I declare" | "I say it outright" | "I flatly refuse", "I deny" (each decides between "declare" and "refuse"); the note says the verb can mean either |
| κυκλήσομεν (7.332) · ποιήσομεν (7.339) · ὀρύξομεν (7.341) | "let us wheel" · "let us make" · "let us dig" | "let us … haul" · "let us make" · "let us dig" | "we shall wheel", "we shall make" (the -ομεν forms in Nestor's plan are read as proposals, with the short-vowel subjunctives κατακήομεν, χεύομεν, δείμομεν); κυκλέω "wheel" |
| ἄκριτον (τύμβον … ἄκριτον, 7.337) | "unsorted" | "one undivided mound" | "common", "indiscriminate", "undivided" in `l` (each decides how the word works); ἄκριτος keeps the Iliad table’s "unsorted" in `l` (2.246, 2.796, 3.412), and `i` gives the sense a mound for all needs; the Odyssey’s adverbial ἄκριτον "endlessly" is a different use, and the note names the other reading ("without sorting") |
| εἶλαρ (7.338) | "shelter" | "shelter" | "bulwark" (reserved for ἕρκος), "defence", "protection"; follows the Odyssey's εἶλαρ "shelter" (κύματος εἶλαρ, odyssey-024) |
| ἱππηλασίη ὁδός (7.340) | "a horse-driving road" | "a road for driving horses" | "chariot-road", "carriage-way" (each fixes the vehicle); ἵππος + ἐλαύνω |
| πυκινὸν ἔπος (7.375) | "a shrewd word" | "a shrewd word" | "a wise word", "a prudent word" (πεπνυμένος is "prudent"); πυκινά "shrewd" as in odyssey-043 |
